summary: Fixed QA-1: added R6 tests for toggle mode under the default and explicit system theme with a mocked matchMedia (light and dark OS), including an OS change while on that keeps aria-pressed=true and toggleOn and swaps force-light/force-dark. Tests only; no production code changed.

tests.name: R1: an empty toggleOptions object enables toggle mode, off by default
R1: removing toggleOptions returns a plain button with no aria-pressed
R1: a button without toggleOptions keeps no aria-pressed after a click
R2: self-managed toggle starts off, flips per click and reports each value
R2: defaultPressed starts the toggle on
R2: a controlled toggle only changes when the app passes a new pressed value
R2: an app that ignores onPressedChange keeps seeing its fixed value
R2: pressed wins when both pressed and defaultPressed are given
R2: two rapid clicks flip twice, once per click
R2: the existing onClick still runs on each click as well as onPressedChange
R3: the check mark and pressed look show only when on, and the check is hidden from screen readers
R3: the on-state check is a different element from the async success checkmark
R3: the on look is applied with buttonStyle %s
R3: a very long label keeps the check mark and the label together
R3: a reduced-motion rule switches the check animation off
R4: the check defaults to the start of the button, before the label
R4: checkPosition 'end' places the check after the label
R4: an unknown checkPosition falls back to the start instead of hiding the check
R4: iconLeft with the check at the start keeps both, icon first, and does not reorder
R4: iconRight with the check at the end keeps both, icon before the check
R4: with stretch the check stays inside the content next to the label
R5: it stays a button (no switch role) that reports pressed
R5: an icon-only toggle exposes its name and pressed state
R5: a keyboard click (Enter/Space activate the native button) flips it once
R5: holding Enter down does not repeat the activation
R5: a first Enter press is not suppressed and the developer's onKeyDown still runs
R5: the focus ring is defined for the on state
R6: the on look combines with the %s theme
R6: a theme change while on keeps it on
R6: with the default system theme and an OS set to %s, the on look gets %s
R6: with theme 'system' the toggle follows an OS change while on
R6: the on state has its own hover and active rules and uses rem, not px
R7: a disabled toggle ignores clicks and still shows its state
R7: while busy, clicks do not flip the toggle
R7: with confirmOptions the first click does not flip, the confirming click flips once
R7: letting the confirmation time out leaves the state unchanged
R7: with a dropdown only the main part toggles and opening the menu keeps the state
R7: if onClick rejects, the toggle keeps the value it flipped to
R7: a semanticType keeps its label and icon defaults and still shows the on look
R8: the API page documents every ToggleOptions prop and the README shows a toggle example
R8: the documented examples type-check against the exported types and render
R9: toggle mode adds no listeners or timers that survive unmount
R2: starts off when nothing is given and flips once per toggle, reporting each value
R2: defaultPressed starts the toggle on
R2: two toggles in the same tick flip twice, not merged or lost
R2: a controlled value does not change until the app passes a new one
R2: pressed wins over defaultPressed
R9: reports the resulting state, with no timers left running
